question: List the bowlers (including their ID, first name, and last name), match number, game number, handicap score, tournament date, and location for only those bowlers who have won games with a handicap score of 190 or less at all three venues: Thunderbird Lanes, Totem Lanes, and Bolero Lanes. Only include the specific game records where they won with a handicap score of 190 or less at these three locations.
sql:
-- Get the specific game records for bowlers who won with handicap <= 190 at all three venues
WITH venue_match_ids AS (
    SELECT tm.MatchID, t.TourneyID, t.TourneyLocation, t.TourneyDate
    FROM Tourney_Matches tm
    JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
    WHERE t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
),
bowler_wins AS (
    SELECT bs.BowlerID, bs.MatchID, bs.GameNumber, bs.HandiCapScore, vmi.TourneyLocation, vmi.TourneyDate
    FROM Bowler_Scores bs
    JOIN venue_match_ids vmi ON bs.MatchID = vmi.MatchID
    WHERE bs.WonGame = 1 AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
),
qualifying_bowlers AS (
    SELECT BowlerID
    FROM bowler_wins
    GROUP BY BowlerID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TourneyLocation) = 3
)
SELECT bw.BowlerID, b.BowlerFirstName, b.BowlerLastName, 
       bw.MatchID, bw.GameNumber, bw.HandiCapScore, bw.TourneyDate, bw.TourneyLocation
FROM bowler_wins bw
JOIN qualifying_bowlers qb ON bw.BowlerID = qb.BowlerID
JOIN Bowlers b ON bw.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
ORDER BY bw.BowlerID, bw.TourneyLocation, bw.MatchID, bw.GameNumber
